selection: the main reason of each global problem
the reasons and the solutions of each global problem
description: The most relevant reason of each global problem of the start page ranking with the potential loss that it causes, shown in the reason column of the ranking beside the climate gas emissions of global warming (solution_prio.json). The most relevant reason is the reason whose mechanism the annual potential loss of the problem measures, as the description of the annual GDP share in the problem file states, so this reason causes the whole loss of the row: its loss is the annual GDP share of the problem times the world GDP of 110.047 trillion EUR, the same calculation as the potential loss of the row. Each reason is the phrase of the reasons file of the problem, repeated here with the same definition. A value names the problem itself, because the start page takes it into the reason column of the problem row; it carries 'assumed', because the annual GDP share it is calculated from is assumed. The reasons of each problem except proprietary software are linked to '<problem> reason' (reason of the problem) like the reasons of global warming to 'global warming reason': the main reason and every '<problem> can cause <reason>' target of the reasons file of the problem, so that the reason cell of the start page row shows ', ...' with a link to the table of the reasons; only the main reason has a potential loss here, so the table lists the other reasons once they get a loss. The start page solution of each problem is linked to '<problem> solution' (solution of the problem) like the solutions of global warming, which is re-declared verbatim where the problem file has the list already; citizen participation also links the solidarity compass, the second solution of its problem file, while the other problems without a list have only the start page solution, so their solution cell shows no ', ...'. Proprietary software is left out on purpose as the sample row with only one reason and one solution and without any ', ...'. Each '<problem> reason' is a 'global problem reason' and each '<problem> solution' is a 'global problem solution', which assigns the reasons and the solutions to the global problems. This file is imported last, so that the database ids of every other phrase stay unchanged.

values.description: the potential loss of populism is the measured decline of the GDP per capita under populist leaders (problem_populism.json), so this reason causes the whole loss: 3.6348 percent of the world GDP of 110.047 trillion EUR

the potential loss of poverty is the gap to the level at which the basic needs are met, food first (problem_poverty.json), so this reason causes the whole loss: 1.8174 percent of the world GDP of 110.047 trillion EUR

the potential loss of ill health is the lost labour input and the avoidable treatment cost, the output that the economy loses (problem_health.json), so this reason causes the whole loss: 4.998 percent of the world GDP of 110.047 trillion EUR

the potential loss of the lack of education is the lifetime earnings lost by the learning poor (problem_education.json), so this reason causes the whole loss: 0.4998 percent of the world GDP of 110.047 trillion EUR

the potential loss of the wealth concentration is the capital misallocation and the lost demand, the growth that is lost (problem_wealth_concentration.json), so this reason causes the whole loss: 1.2722 percent of the world GDP of 110.047 trillion EUR

the potential loss of disinformation is its effect on the quality of the political decisions (problem_disinformation.json), so this reason causes the whole loss: 0.318 percent of the world GDP of 110.047 trillion EUR

the potential loss of the market power is the deadweight loss from the markups (problem_market_power.json), so this reason causes the whole loss: 1.4539 percent of the world GDP of 110.047 trillion EUR

the potential loss of the biased information is the value destroyed by public decisions taken on incomplete information, e.g. projects approved on underestimated costs (problem_biased_information.json), so this reason causes the whole loss: 0.4089 percent of the world GDP of 110.047 trillion EUR

the potential loss of the black-box AI is the cost of the wrong decisions taken on an AI output that cannot be checked (problem_black_box_ai.json), so this reason causes the whole loss: 0.1999 percent of the world GDP of 110.047 trillion EUR

the potential loss of the missing citizen participation is the public money spent against the preferences of the citizens (problem_citizen_participation.json), so this reason causes the whole loss: 0.16357 percent of the world GDP of 110.047 trillion EUR

the potential loss of the GDP mismeasurement is the steering error of the understated GDP that a revision of the national accounts corrects (problem_gdp_mismeasurement.json), so this reason causes the whole loss: 0.22718 percent of the world GDP of 110.047 trillion EUR

the potential loss of the proprietary software is the licence spending extended to the lock-in cost (problem_proprietary_software.json), so this reason causes the whole loss: 0.09087 percent of the world GDP of 110.047 trillion EUR
